artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:5419:description: "Use when the user asks how to build with OpenAI products or APIs, asks about Codex itself or choosing Codex surfaces, needs up-to-date official documentation with citations, help choosing the latest model for a use case, or model upgrade and prompt-upgrade guidance; use OpenAI docs MCP tools for non-Codex docs questions, use the Codex manual helper first for broad Codex self-knowledge, and restrict fallback browsing to official OpenAI domains."
artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:5447:## OpenAI product snapshots
artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:5459:Use this path for questions about Codex itself: configuring, extending, operating, troubleshooting, local state, product surfaces, or where Codex behavior should live. A codebase merely mentioning a plugin, skill, hook, MCP server, browser, or automation is not enough. For generic software tasks, answer the software task directly; if asked whether Codex self-knowledge applies, answer that meta question briefly and continue the requested artifact.
artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:5463:The Codex manual is the first source for broad Codex synthesis. Treat the manual and Docs MCP as different lanes, not interchangeable official-doc sources. For published-user Codex product answers, the source route is complete: the manual, Docs MCP when this route calls for it, official OpenAI web fallback, and callable capabilities surfaced in the current session when the question is about that capability. Knowledge bases outside developers.openai.com are outside this route for public product answers.
artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:5480:The helper verifies freshness, writes `codex-manual.md`, and emits `codex-manual.outline.md`. The outline maps source pages and headings to line ranges; use it to choose the relevant manual section, then read or search targeted manual sections for Codex product facts. Use the skill directory to locate and run the helper; after the helper succeeds, use the returned manual and outline paths as the search scope for Codex product facts and term coverage checks.
artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:5492:Use the narrowest official next source only when the manual is unavailable, the helper fails, temp caching is not allowed, another material claim is missing or likely stale, or the user explicitly needs a page-specific citation. Prefer one specific Docs MCP search and, if it returns a clearly relevant page, one fetch; for unresolved Codex capability names, acronyms, scheduling terms, or exact error text, this Docs MCP step is the next source before web search. After the manual plus any permitted Docs MCP gap-fill, resolve remaining gaps as bounded uncertainty. Use official-domain web fallback only after that Docs MCP path is unavailable or unhelpful. If the claim is still not established, stop with bounded uncertainty. If official docs/manual conflict with a callable capability already surfaced in the current session, state the conflict and prefer verified current-session behavior for that environment.
artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:5494:For undocumented or private-looking model slugs, product mode labels, entitlement labels, account access paths, or rollout names, answer from current public docs and bounded uncertainty. Those labels are not a reason to leave the public source route.
artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:5498:If the source route still does not establish a claim, return bounded uncertainty or route to support, an admin, or product feedback instead of widening the investigation.
artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:5500:For unresolved product terminology, answer from the manual plus the allowed official next source. If those sources do not establish the term, answer with bounded uncertainty from those sources.
artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:5518:Use this quick product map when needed: CLI is terminal-first local repo work; IDE extension is editor-attached coding; Codex app is desktop planning, review, and interactive work; cloud/web is hosted parallel/offloaded work; Browser Use/in-app browser is Codex-controlled web testing; Chrome extension uses the user's Chrome profile; Computer Use controls desktop apps and OS UI. Keep `config.toml` defaults, `requirements.toml` constraints, and managed/admin policy separate.

artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:6169:chatgpt-app-submission.json:7:    "description": "Atlas opens your county inside ChatGPT as an explorable voxel city map. Browse the streets, ask closed-world local questions, and drop Clawd — an AI companion — onto a place to scout opportunity signals, risks, and a route, then generate a manual 7-day campaign preview. Whether you're sizing up a local business, exploring your town, or researching a market, it all happens in the chat and is session-only: Atlas saves no state, provider data, XP, accounts, checkout, posts, messages, ad buys, scraped lists, or live campaign execution. Riverside/Eastvale is the playable Alpha; other California counties show honest coverage status. artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:7205:docs\DECISIONS.md:1676:Atlas V1 should target the entire United States, but not by rendering a giant national canvas. The backend owns national indexing, provider adapters, cache/TTL/source policy, and normalized country/state/county/district/place identity. The renderer consumes bounded `CityWorldScene` slices for the selected county or district. Additional MCP servers or connectors should be added only when they solve a concrete deploy, provider, database, or submission-review bottleneck.
artifacts\council\directory-reviewer.md:7208:docs\DECISIONS.md:1692:Atlas work progresses through named maturity levels: mock scaffold, curated Alpha, verified live read-only, persisted Beta, and production release. Any slice that promotes mocks, curated claims, live provider scope, persistence, money, or automation must name the human approval gate before it crosses that boundary.

Key docs: docs/NORTH_STARS.md, docs/ENGINE_TODO.md, docs/V1_PRODUCTION_BACKLOG.md, AGENTS.md, chatgpt-app-submission.json, artifacts/emulator/audit/REPORT.md, artifacts/engine-todo/*.md. Source: server/src/index.ts, web/src/*, packages/core/src/voxel/*. You CANNOT view images — ground critique in code, docs, metrics, and prod probes. BE HARSH AND SPECIFIC: your job is to find what is weak, missing, fake, or embarrassing — not to praise. Output EXACTLY: a ranked list of your TOP 5 findings, each with [SEVERITY critical/high/medium], a one-line finding, 2-4 lines of evidence (file:line or probe result), and a one-line concrete fix. No preamble.

This renderer allows you to use the next-generation graphics API, WebGPU.\n * ```ts\n * // Create a new renderer\n * const renderer = new WebGPURenderer();\n * await renderer.init();\n *\n * // Add the renderer to the stage\n * document.body.appendChild(renderer.canvas);\n *\n * // Create a new stage\n * const stage = new Container();\n *\n * // Render the stage\n * renderer.render(stage);\n * ```\n *\n * You can use {@link autoDetectRenderer} to create a renderer that will automatically detect the best\n * renderer for the environment.\n * ```ts\n * import { autoDetectRenderer } from 'pixi.js';\n * // Create a new renderer\n * const renderer = await autoDetectRenderer();\n * ```\n *\n * The renderer is composed of systems that manage specific tasks.  153: function railwayJson(args) {
 154:   try {
 155:     const output = process.platform === "win32"
 156:       ? execFileSync("powershell", ["-NoProfile", "-Command", `railway ${args.join(" ")}`], { encoding: "utf8" })

 158:     return JSON.parse(output);
 159:   } catch (error) {
 160:     blockers.push(`Railway command failed: railway ${args.join(" ")}`);
 161:     return {};
 162:   }
 163: }

 165: function requireVar(vars, name) {
 166:   if (!Object.hasOwn(vars, name) || String(vars[name] || "") === "") {
 167:     blockers.push(`atlas-backend production variable is missing: ${name}`);
 168:   }
 169: }

 171: async function fetchJson(url) {
 172:   try {
 173:     const response = await fetch(url);
 174:     const body = await response.text();
 175:     let payload = {};
 176:     if (body.trim()) {
 177:       try {
 178:         payload = JSON.parse(body);
 179:       } catch {
 180:         payload = { body };
 181:       }
 182:     }
 183:     if (!response.ok) {
 184:       blockers.push(`${url} returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
 185:       return payload;
 186:     }
 187:     return payload;
 188:   } catch (error) {
 189:     blockers.push(`${url} request failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
 190:     return {};
 191:   }
 192: }

Local `ATLAS_MCP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8792/mcp pnpm verify:mcp` passed with tools `get_upgrade_options`, `lookup_world_places`, `preview_campaign_engine`, `preview_scout_drop`, and `render_voxel_county`; the lookup call returned 20 places. Local HTTP smoke for `/api/world/lookup?query=Eastvale%2C%20CA&radiusMeters=3500` still returned Google mode, 20 normalized places, and no raw provider fields.
docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6638:Deployment `e082c53d-7d7c-42ac-ba52-28dfaa2fa1dc` succeeded. Public `ATLAS_MCP_URL=https://atlas-backend-production-e6fc.up.railway.app/mcp pnpm verify:mcp` passed with all five tools, including `lookup_world_places`, and the lookup call returned 20 places. Public HTTP lookup still returned Google mode, 20 normalized places, categories fitness, food/drink, landmark, park, school, service, and shop, with no raw provider fields.
docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6649:Added a bounded in-memory cache for successful world lookup responses, keyed by normalized query, radius, and adapter mode. Lookup responses now include runtime cache metadata: `cacheHit`, `cachedAt`, and `expiresAt`. The MCP verifier now calls `lookup_world_places` twice and expects the second identical call to hit cache.
docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6655:`pnpm test:core`, `pnpm build:server`, and `pnpm typecheck:starter` passed. Local `ATLAS_MCP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8793/mcp pnpm verify:mcp` passed with `cachedLookup: true`, proving the second identical `lookup_world_places` call hit cache. Local HTTP `/api/world/lookup?query=Eastvale%2C%20CA&radiusMeters=3500` exposed runtime cache metadata.
docs\BUILD_LOG.md:6810:Public `ATLAS_MCP_URL=https://atlas-backend-production-e6fc.up.railway.app/mcp pnpm verify:mcp` passed after rollout attempt 3 with the seven-tool surface: `ask_county_question`, `get_upgrade_options`, `lookup_world_places`, `preview_campaign_engine`, `preview_scout_drop`, `render_voxel_county`, and `select_county`. Public `pnpm verify:submission` passed with `countyQuestionTopic: "business_signals"` and `unsupportedCountyQuestion: false`. Public `pnpm verify:preview:http` passed for `https://atlas-backend-production-e6fc.up.railway.app/preview` with 806196 bytes and city-world markup.

Their resolved climate was `arid`, so `bonusZoneFor(...)` stripped the water bonus zone into a dry plaza. {context.primaryAction.label}\n        </button>\n        <button type=\"button\" className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-close\" aria-label=\"Close Atlas save panel\" onClick={onClose}>\n          <CloseIcon />\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      {expanded ? (\n        <div id=\"hosted-clawd-sheet-body\" className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-body\" data-qa=\"hosted-clawd-sheet-body\">\n          <header className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-head\">\n            <div>\n              <strong>Save with ChatGPT</strong>\n              <p>{saveReadiness.detail}</p>\n            </div>\n            <button\n              ref={closeButtonRef}\n              type=\"button\"\n              className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-collapse\"\n              aria-label=\"Collapse Atlas save panel\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                setExpanded(false);\n                window.requestAnimationFrame(() => expandButtonRef.current?.focus());\n              }}\n            >\n              Collapse\n            </button>\n          </header>\n\n          <div className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-state\" role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\" data-qa=\"hosted-clawd-session-state\">\n            <span>{saveReadiness.title}</span>\n          </div>\n\n          <section\n            className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-save-strip\"\n            aria-label=\"Saved workflow items\"\n            data-qa=\"hosted-clawd-save-strip\"\n            data-qa-save-readiness={saveReadiness.status}\n            data-qa-save-ready-count={saveReadiness.readyCount}\n          >\n            <ol className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-save-slots\" aria-label=\"Saved items\">\n              {saveReadiness.slots.map((slot, index) => (\n                <li key={`${slot.id}-${index}`} aria-label={`${slot.label}: ${saveSlotValue(slot)}`} data-status={slot.status} data-qa={`hosted-clawd-save-slot-${slot.id}`}>\n                  <span aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                  <div>\n                    <strong title={slot.label}>{slot.label}</strong>\n                    <p title={saveSlotValue(slot)}>{saveSlotValue(slot)}</p>\n                  </div>\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ol>\n          </section>\n\n          {savedShelf ? (\n            <section\n              className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-saved-shelf\"\n              aria-label=\"Saved Atlas state\"\n              data-qa=\"hosted-clawd-saved-shelf\"\n              data-qa-saved-read-only={savedShelf.readOnly ? \"true\" : \"false\"}\n              data-qa-saved-record-count={savedShelf.recordCount}\n            >\n              <div className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-saved-head\">\n                <span>Saved items</span>\n                <strong>{savedShelf.title}</strong>\n                <p>{savedShelf.detail}</p>\n              </div>\n              <ul className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-saved-list\">\n                {savedShelf.rows.map((row) => (\n                  <li key={row.id} data-kind={row.kind}>\n                    <span aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                    <div>\n                      <strong>{row.label}</strong>\n                      <p>{row.detail}</p>\n                    </div>\n                  </li>\n                ))}\n              </ul>\n            </section>\n          ) : null}\n\n          <section className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-setup\" aria-label=\"Atlas workflow steps\" data-qa=\"hosted-clawd-setup-rail\" data-qa-setup-console=\"grey\">\n            <ol className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-stage-buttons\" aria-label=\"Workflow steps\">\n              {visibleSetupSteps.map((step, index) => (\n                <li\n                  key={step.id}\n                  className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-stage-button\"\n                  aria-current={step.id === activeSetupStepId ? \"step\" : undefined}\n                  aria-label={`${step.label}: ${step.statusLabel}. ${step.detail}`}\n                  data-status={step.status}\n                  data-qa={`hosted-clawd-setup-${step.id}`}\n                >\n                  <span aria-hidden=\"true\">{index + 1}</span>\n                  {step.label}\n                </li>\n              ))}\n            </ol>\n          </section>\n\n          {actionMessage ? (\n            <p className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-action-message\" role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\" data-qa=\"hosted-clawd-action-message\">\n              {actionMessage}\n            </p>\n          ) : null}\n        </div>\n      ) : actionMessage ? (\n        <p className=\"city-world-hosted-clawd-action-message\" role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\" data-qa=\"hosted-clawd-action-message\">\n          {actionMessage}\n        </p>\n      ) : null}\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\ntype HostedClawdSaveSlot = {\n  id: string;\n  label: string;\n  detail: string;\n  status: \"ready\" | \"pending\" | \"locked\";\n};\n\ntype HostedClawdSaveReadiness = {\n  status: \"session\" | \"needs_account\" | \"ready\";\n  kicker: string;\n  title: string;\n  detail: string;\n  readyCount: number;\n  slots: HostedClawdSaveSlot[];\n};\n\nfunction saveReadinessForContext(context: HostedClawdContext, closedGateCount: number): HostedClawdSaveReadiness {\n  const slots = context.savePreview.map((item): HostedClawdSaveSlot => ({\n    id: saveSlotId(item.label),\n    label: item.label,\n    detail: item.value,\n    status: item.status === \"ready\" ? \"ready\" : item.status === \"needs_confirmation\" ? \"pending\" : \"locked\",\n  }));\n  const readyCount = slots.filter((slot) => slot.status === \"ready\").length;\n  const status = context.canPersist ? \"ready\" : closedGateCount > 0 ? \"session\" : \"needs_account\";\n\n  if (context.canPersist) {\n    return {\n      status,\n      kicker: \"Saved setup\",\n      title: `${readyCount}/${slots.length} ready`,\n      detail: \"Save confirmed business, map, Scout Drop, and campaign draft.\",\n      readyCount,\n      slots,\n    };\n  }\n\n  return {\n    status,\n    kicker: \"Local view\",\n    title: `${readyCount}/${slots.length} ready in this chat`,\n    detail:\n      closedGateCount > 0\n        ? \"This chat is temporary. Connect an account before anything can be saved.\"\n        : \"Connect an account to save this setup.\",\n    readyCount,\n    slots,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction saveSlotId(label: string): string {\n  return label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, \"-\").replace(/^-|-$/g, \"\") || \"slot\";\n}\n\nfunction saveSlotValue(slot: HostedClawdSaveSlot): string {\n  if (slot.status === \"locked\") return \"Not ready\";\n  if (slot.status === \"pending\") return slot.detail;\n  if (slot.label === \"Scout report\" || slot.label === \"Campaign draft\") return \"Saved\";\n  return slot.detail;\n}\n\ntype HostedClawdSavedShelfRow = {\n  id: string;\n  kind: \"clawd\" | \"business\" | \"scout\" | \"campaign\" | \"empty\";\n  label: string;\n  detail: string;\n};\n\ntype HostedClawdSavedShelf = {\n  title: string;\n  detail: string;\n  recordCount: number;\n  readOnly: boolean;\n  rows: HostedClawdSavedShelfRow[];\n};\n\nfunction savedShelfForContext(context: HostedClawdContext): HostedClawdSavedShelf | null {\n  const savedState = context.savedState;\n  if (!savedState) return null;\n\n  const rows: HostedClawdSavedShelfRow[] = [];\n  if (savedState.clawd) {\n    rows.push({\n      id: `clawd-${savedState.clawd.id}`,\n      kind: \"clawd\",\n      label: savedState.clawd.name,\n      detail: \"Saved assistant\",\n    });\n  }\n  if (savedState.businessProfile) {\n    const place = savedState.businessProfile.placeLabel ?? savedState.businessProfile.countyLabel ?? savedState.businessProfile.countySlug;\n    rows.push({\n      id: `business-${savedState.businessProfile.id}`,\n      kind: \"business\",\n      label: savedState.businessProfile.name,\n      detail: `${savedState.businessProfile.businessType ?? \"Business profile\"} - ${place}`,\n    });\n  }\n  if (savedState.scoutDrops.length > 0) {\n    const latest = savedState.scoutDrops[0];\n    if (latest) {\n      rows.push({\n        id: `scout-${latest.id}`,\n        kind: \"scout\",\n        label: `${savedState.scoutDrops.length} saved Scout Drop${savedState.scoutDrops.length === 1 ? \"\" : \"s\"}`,\n        detail: `Latest preview ${latest.scoutPreviewId}`,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n  if (savedState.campaignDrafts.length > 0) {\n    const latest = savedState.campaignDrafts[0];\n    if (latest) {\n      rows.push({\n        id: `campaign-${latest.id}`,\n        kind: \"campaign\",\n        label: `${savedState.campaignDrafts.length} campaign draft${savedState.campaignDrafts.length === 1 ? \"\" : \"s\"}`,\n        detail: latest.summary ?? `Preview ${latest.campaignPreviewId}`,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  const recordCount =\n    (savedState.clawd ? 1 : 0) +\n    (savedState.businessProfile ? 1 : 0) +\n    savedState.scoutDrops.length +\n    savedState.campaignDrafts.length;\n\n  if (rows.length === 0) {\n    rows.push({\n      id: \"empty\",\n      kind: \"empty\",\n      label: \"Nothing saved yet\",\n      detail: \"Start from this map.\",\n    });\n  }\n\n  return {\n    title: recordCount === 0 ? \"No saved state yet\" : `${recordCount} saved in ChatGPT`,\n    detail:\n      savedState.readOnlyReason === \"billing_attention\"\n        ? \"Saved history is readable. New saves are paused.\"\n        : savedState.paidWrites === \"enabled\"\n          ? \"Saved history is loaded. New saves are on.\"\n          : \"Saved history is readable. New saves are locked.\",\n    recordCount,\n    readOnly: savedState.paidWrites === \"read_only\",\n    rows,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction CloseIcon() {\n  return (\n    <svg className=\"city-world-icon\" viewBox=\"0 0 20 20\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <path d=\"m5.5 5.5 9 9M14.5 5.5l-9 9\" />\n    </svg>\n  );\n}\n\ntype HostedClawdSetupStep = {\n  id: string;\n  label: string;\n  detail: string;\n  status: \"ready\" | \"needs_confirmation\" | \"planned\" | \"blocked\";\n  statusLabel: string;\n};\n\nfunction setupStepsForContext(context: HostedClawdContext, closedGateCount: number): HostedClawdSetupStep[] {\n  const business = findSavePreviewItem(context, \"Business\");\n  const scout = findSavePreviewItem(context, \"Scout report\");\n  const campaign = findSavePreviewItem(context, \"Campaign draft\");\n\n  return [\n    {\n      id: \"wake\",\n      label: \"Open\",\n      detail: \"Open setup on this map\",\n      status: \"ready\",\n      statusLabel: \"Ready\",\n    },\n    setupStepFromPreview(\"target\", \"Target\", business, \"Pick a business from the map\"),\n    setupStepFromPreview(\"scout\", \"Scout\", scout, \"Run a Scout Drop\"),\n    setupStepFromPreview(\"campaign\", \"Campaign\", campaign, \"Preview the first campaign\"),\n    {\n      id: \"gate\",\n      label: \"Account\",\n      detail: closedGateCount > 0 ? `${formatCount(closedGateCount, \"setup step\")} locked` : \"Account ready\",\n      status: closedGateCount > 0 ? \"blocked\" : \"ready\",\n      statusLabel: closedGateCount > 0 ? \"Locked\" : \"Ready\",\n    },\n    {\n      id: \"proof\",\n      label: \"Save\",\n      detail: context.canPersist ? \"Confirm before saving\" : \"Saving is not live yet\",\n      status: context.canPersist ? \"ready\" : \"blocked\",\n      statusLabel: context.canPersist ? \"Ready\" : \"Locked\",\n    },\n  ];\n}\n\nfunction formatCount(count: number, singular: string, plural = `${singular}s`) {\n  return `${count} ${count === 1 ? singular : plural}`;\n}\n\nfunction findSavePreviewItem(context: HostedClawdContext, label: string) {\n  return context.savePreview.find((item) => item.label === label);\n}\n\nfunction setupStepFromPreview(\n  id: string,\n  label: string,\n  item: HostedClawdContext[\"savePreview\"][number] | undefined,\n  fallback: string,\n): HostedClawdSetupStep {\n  const status = item?.status ?? \"needs_confirmation\";\n  return {\n    id,\n    label,\n    detail: item?.value ?? fallback,\n    status,\n    statusLabel: setupStatusLabel(status),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction setupStatusLabel(status: HostedClawdSetupStep[\"status\"]): string {\n  switch (status) {\n    case \"ready\":\n      return \"Ready\";\n    case \"needs_confirmation\":\n      return \"Check\";\n    case \"planned\":\n      return \"Next\";\n    case \"blocked\":\n      return \"Locked\";\n  }\n}\n", "import { Children, Fragment, type ReactNode } from \"react\";\r\nimport { Collapsible, ScrollArea, Separator } from \"radix-ui\";\r\nimport type {\r\n  CampaignPreviewState,\r\n  ScoutPreviewState,\r\n  ScoutRisk,\r\n  ScoutSignal,\r\n} from \"@atlas/core/scout\";\r\n\r\nexport type PreviewPanelProps = {\r\n  scoutPreview?: ScoutPreviewState | null;\r\n  campaignPreview?: CampaignPreviewState | null;\r\n  onAdvance?: () => void;\r\n};\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * Result surface for the Scout Drop and Campaign previews.\r\n *\r\n * The MCP tools already return route, signals, risks, channels, a 7-day plan,\r\n * and asset placeholders in `_meta`. Before this panel the widget dropped all of\r\n * it and only re-rendered the map, so the scouting result showed up only as a\r\n * plaintext chat bubble. This renders it inside the app as a bounded, map-first\r\n * overlay. It stays honest: nothing here is saved, sent, or scheduled.\r\n */\r\nexport function PreviewPanel({ scoutPreview, campaignPreview, onAdvance }: PreviewPanelProps) {\r\n  if (campaignPreview) return <CampaignPanel preview={campaignPreview} {...(onAdvance ? { onAdvance } : {})} />;\r\n  if (scoutPreview) return <ScoutPanel preview={scoutPreview} {...(onAdvance ? { onAdvance } : {})} />;\r\n  return null;\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction ScoutPanel({ preview, onAdvance }: { preview: ScoutPreviewState; onAdvance?: () => void }) {\r\n  return (\r\n    <section\r\n      className=\"city-world-preview\"\r\n      aria-label=\"Scout drop result\"\r\n      data-qa=\"preview-panel\"\r\n      data-qa-preview-kind=\"scout\"\r\n      data-qa-signal-count={preview.signals.length}\r\n    >\r\n      <header className=\"city-world-preview-head\">\r\n        <span className=\"city-world-preview-kicker\">Scout drop \u00B7 {preview.businessType}</span>\r\n        <strong data-qa=\"preview-title\">{preview.summary}</strong>\r\n      </header>\r\n\r\n      <PreviewBody>\r\n        <PreviewSections>\r\n          {preview.bestOffer ? (\r\n            <div className=\"city-world-preview-offer\" data-qa=\"preview-best-offer\">\r\n              <span>Best offer</span>\r\n              <p>{preview.bestOffer}</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n          ) : null}\r\n\r\n          {preview.signals.length > 0 ? (\r\n            <SectionBlock title=\"Signals\" count={preview.signals.length}>\r\n              <ul className=\"city-world-preview-signals\" data-qa=\"preview-signals\">\r\n                {preview.signals.map((signal) => (\r\n                  <SignalRow key={signal.id} signal={signal} />\r\n                ))}\r\n              </ul>\r\n            </SectionBlock>\r\n          ) : null}\r\n\r\n          {preview.route.length > 0 ? (\r\n            <CollapsibleSection title=\"Route\" count={preview.route.length}>\r\n              <ol className=\"city-world-preview-route\">\r\n                {preview.route.map((stop) => (\r\n                  <li key={stop.nodeId}>\r\n                    <strong>{stop.label}</strong>\r\n                    <span>{stop.reason}</span>\r\n                  </li>\r\n                ))}\r\n              </ol>\r\n            </CollapsibleSection>\r\n          ) : null}\r\n\r\n          {preview.risks.length > 0 ? (\r\n            <SectionBlock title=\"Watch-outs\" count={preview.risks.length}>\r\n              <ul className=\"city-world-preview-risks\">\r\n                {preview.risks.map((risk) => (\r\n                  <RiskRow key={risk.id} risk={risk} />\r\n                ))}\r\n              </ul>\r\n            </SectionBlock>\r\n          ) : null}\r\n\r\n          {preview.channels.length > 0 ? (\r\n            <SectionBlock title=\"Channels\" count={preview.channels.length}>\r\n              <ul className=\"city-world-preview-token-list\" aria-label=\"Scout channels\">\r\n                {preview.channels.map((channel) => (\r\n                  <li key={channel}>\r\n                    <span className=\"city-world-preview-token\">{formatLabel(channel)}</span>\r\n                  </li>\r\n                ))}\r\n              </ul>\r\n            </SectionBlock>\r\n          ) : null}\r\n\r\n          {preview.nextActions.length > 0 ? (\r\n            <SectionBlock title=\"Next moves\" count={preview.nextActions.length}>\r\n              <ul className=\"city-world-preview-list\">\r\n                {preview.nextActions.map((action, index) => (\r\n                  <li key={index}>{action}</li>\r\n                ))}\r\n              </ul>\r\n            </SectionBlock>\r\n          ) : null}\r\n        </PreviewSections>\r\n      </PreviewBody>\r\n\r\n      <SessionFooter note={preview.upgradePrompt} advanceLabel=\"Preview 7-day campaign\" {...(onAdvance ? { onAdvance } : {})} />\r\n    </section>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction CampaignPanel({ preview, onAdvance }: { preview: CampaignPreviewState; onAdvance?: () => void }) {\r\n  return (\r\n    <section\r\n      className=\"city-world-preview\"\r\n      aria-label=\"Campaign preview\"\r\n      data-qa=\"preview-panel\"\r\n      data-qa-preview-kind=\"campaign\"\r\n      data-qa-day-count={preview.days.length}\r\n    >\r\n      <header className=\"city-world-preview-head\">\r\n        <span className=\"city-world-preview-kicker\">7-day campaign \u00B7 {preview.businessType}</span>\r\n        <strong data-qa=\"preview-title\">{preview.summary}</strong>\r\n      </header>\r\n\r\n      <PreviewBody>\r\n        <PreviewSections>\r\n          {preview.offer ? (\r\n            <div className=\"city-world-preview-offer\" data-qa=\"preview-best-offer\">\r\n              <span>Offer</span>\r\n              <p>{preview.offer}</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n          ) : null}\r\n\r\n          {preview.days.length > 0 ? (\r\n            <CollapsibleSection title=\"7-day plan\" count={preview.days.length}>\r\n              <ol className=\"city-world-preview-days\" data-qa=\"preview-days\">\r\n                {preview.days.map((day) => (\r\n                  <li key={day.day}>\r\n                    <span className=\"city-world-preview-day-num\">{day.day}</span>\r\n                    <div className=\"city-world-preview-day-body\">\r\n                      <strong>{day.label}</strong>\r\n                      <p>{day.focus}</p>\r\n                      <div className=\"city-world-preview-day-meta\">\r\n                        <span className=\"city-world-preview-token\">{formatLabel(day.channel)}</span>\r\n                        {day.proof ? <small>Proof: {day.proof}</small> : null}\r\n                      </div>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                  </li>\r\n                ))}\r\n              </ol>\r\n            </CollapsibleSection>\r\n          ) : null}\r\n\r\n          {preview.assetPlaceholders.length > 0 ? (\r\n            <CollapsibleSection title=\"Assets\" count={preview.assetPlaceholders.length}>\r\n              <ul className=\"city-world-preview-assets\">\r\n                {preview.assetPlaceholders.map((asset) => (\r\n                  <li key={asset.id}>\r\n                    <strong>{asset.label}</strong>\r\n                    <span>\r\n                      {formatLabel(asset.format)} \u00B7 {asset.copyIntent}\r\n                    </span>\r\n                  </li>\r\n                ))}\r\n              </ul>\r\n            </CollapsibleSection>\r\n          ) : null}\r\n\r\n          {preview.guardrails.length > 0 ? (\r\n            <SectionBlock title=\"Guardrails\" count={preview.guardrails.length}>\r\n              <ul className=\"city-world-preview-list\">\r\n                {preview.guardrails.map((rail, index) => (\r\n                  <li key={index}>{rail}</li>\r\n                ))}\r\n              </ul>\r\n            </SectionBlock>\r\n          ) : null}\r\n        </PreviewSections>\r\n      </PreviewBody>\r\n\r\n      <SessionFooter advanceLabel=\"Save options\" {...(onAdvance ? { onAdvance } : {})} />\n    </section>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction PreviewBody({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\r\n  return (\r\n    <ScrollArea.Root className=\"city-world-preview-scroll\" type=\"auto\" scrollHideDelay={260}>\r\n      <ScrollArea.Viewport className=\"city-world-preview-viewport\">\r\n        <div className=\"city-world-preview-content\">{children}</div>\r\n      </ScrollArea.Viewport>\r\n      <ScrollArea.Scrollbar className=\"city-world-preview-scrollbar\" orientation=\"vertical\">\r\n        <ScrollArea.Thumb className=\"city-world-preview-thumb\" />\r\n      </ScrollArea.Scrollbar>\r\n      <ScrollArea.Corner className=\"city-world-preview-corner\" />\r\n    </ScrollArea.Root>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction PreviewSections({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\r\n  const sections = Children.toArray(children).filter(Boolean);\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <>\r\n      {sections.map((section, index) => (\r\n        <Fragment key={index}>\r\n          {index > 0 ? <Separator.Root className=\"city-world-preview-separator\" decorative /> : null}\r\n          {section}\r\n        </Fragment>\r\n      ))}\r\n    </>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction SectionBlock({ title, count, children }: { title: string; count: number; children: ReactNode }) {\r\n  return (\r\n    <section className=\"city-world-preview-block\">\r\n      <div className=\"city-world-preview-section-head\">\r\n        <h3>{title}</h3>\r\n        <span>{count}</span>\r\n      </div>\r\n      {children}\r\n    </section>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction CollapsibleSection({ title, count, children }: { title: string; count: number; children: ReactNode }) {\r\n  return (\r\n    <Collapsible.Root className=\"city-world-preview-block city-world-preview-collapsible\" defaultOpen>\r\n      <Collapsible.Trigger type=\"button\" className=\"city-world-preview-section-trigger\">\r\n        <span>{title}</span>\r\n        <b>{count}</b>\r\n        <i aria-hidden=\"true\" />\r\n      </Collapsible.Trigger>\r\n      <Collapsible.Content className=\"city-world-preview-collapsible-content\">{children}</Collapsible.Content>\r\n    </Collapsible.Root>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction SignalRow({ signal }: { signal: ScoutSignal }) {\r\n  const score = Math.round(signal.score);\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <li>\r\n      <div className=\"city-world-preview-signal-head\">\r\n        <span className={`city-world-preview-dot tone-${signal.tone}`} aria-hidden=\"true\" />\r\n        <strong>{signal.label}</strong>\r\n        <span className={`city-world-preview-score tone-${signal.tone}`} aria-label={`Score ${score}`}>\r\n          {score}\r\n        </span>\r\n      </div>\r\n      <p className=\"city-world-preview-detail\">{signal.detail}</p>\r\n    </li>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction RiskRow({ risk }: { risk: ScoutRisk }) {\r\n  return (\r\n    <li>\r\n      <div className=\"city-world-preview-signal-head\">\r\n        <span className={`city-world-preview-dot severity-${risk.severity}`} aria-hidden=\"true\" />\r\n        <strong>{risk.label}</strong>\r\n        <span className={`city-world-preview-severity severity-${risk.severity}`}>{formatLabel(risk.severity)}</span>\r\n      </div>\r\n      <p className=\"city-world-preview-detail\">{risk.mitigation}</p>\r\n    </li>\r\n  );\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction SessionFooter({ note, advanceLabel, onAdvance }: { note?: string; advanceLabel?: string; onAdvance?: () => void }) {\r\n  return (\r\n    <footer className=\"city-world-preview-foot\">\r\n      <div className=\"city-world-preview-boundary\" data-qa=\"preview-session-boundary\">\r\n        Session preview. The production artifact is especially bad for directory review: it reports `persistenceEnabled: true`, `moneyEnabled: true`, and `stripeConfigured: true` while the submission says persistence/checkout are not live. I’m checking whether auth gating compensates for that before ranking it.
